brief: A lightweight on-device speech toolkit for Android. Built for developers who value local capability and the freedom to build.
criteria: Two speech turns form one modular S. Clear at small sizes; useful in a repository, documentation and an Android demo app.

concepts.name: Split S
concepts.idea: Two speech turns, one modular S.
rationale: A direct link to the Sonlet name.
Terracotta adds warmth; ink keeps the toolkit grounded.

recommendation: Use the two-colour horizontal lockup by default. Use the small-size cut at 16–24 px and dedicated reversed artwork on dark surfaces.
next_steps: Master SVGs contain filled paths only, with no font dependency.
Web icons and Android adaptive layers are included.
Screenshots are illustrative applications, not a shipped product UI.
